evidence.title: Agility Robotics to Attend Upcoming Investor Conferences
evidence.excerpt: SALEM, Ore., August 27, 2026 - Agility Robotics, a leading humanoid robotics and Physical AI company, today announced that the Company will be attending the following investor conferences through the end of the third quarter: Citi Global TMT Conference Date: September 8-10, 2026 Location: New York, New York ‍ Jefferies Global Industrials Conference Date: September 9-10, 2026 Location: New York, New York ‍ ‍ Evercore ADAS, AV & AI Forum Date: September 29, 2026 Location: New York, New York Robotics Panel: 10:30 – 11:10am ET Agility CFO Michael Beer will be available for one-on-one meetings with institutional investors. To schedule a meeting, please contact the appropriate bank sales representative. This announcement follows Agility’s plans to go public through a merger with Churchill Capital Corp XI ( NASDAQ: CCXI ). About Agility Robotics Agility's commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities and distribution centers – tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work.
